name: Endosomal beta2AR-Gs distribution hypotheses

display.context_label: 内体膜 · Gs 位于胞质侧

orientation_evidence: prepare_molecular_asset beta2 uses UniProt P07550 TM ends to infer +Z extracellular. On an endosome it faces the lumen; the negative-Z Gs partner faces cytosol. Membrane origin/orientation are inferred, not an experimental membrane plane.
biological_context: Schematic endosomal membrane. beta2AR/Gs signaling on early endosomes is supported by Irannejad et al. 2013; the size, count, shape, clusters, excluded cap and all complexes being Gs-associated are illustrative choices, not observations from that study.

sources.role: 3.20 A X-ray active-state beta2AR/nucleotide-free Gs shape; engineered and mixed-species construct
Endosomal beta2AR/Gs signaling context; publisher abstract read, no density or cluster parameters derived

construct_limits: Human beta2AR construct plus bovine G-alpha-s/gamma and rat beta-1; do not relabel as an intact native human complex.
Preserves every selected resolved polymer atom. R residues below 400 retain the receptor portion; engineered T4 fusion and nanobody N are excluded as whole selected components.
Non-polymer P0G agonist is omitted by this surface preset, not interpreted as absence of agonist or an inactive state. No activation/binding animation is claimed.
Source substitutions, unresolved loops/termini, lipid anchors and missing glycans are not repaired.
